page.overview:
Who is Ten Kings?

The are a council that is in charge of managing the Underworld.

When Sun Wukong went on a rampage through the Underworld after being dragged there despite his immortality, the Ten Kings allowed him to look through the Register of Life and Death to see if there had been some kind of mistake. Su Wukong took the opportunity to remove his name and the names of several monkeys from the register, preventing them from being killed. The Ten Kings reported this incident to the Bodhisattva Ksitigarbha.
